title: The chorus
venue: Arthur's site (newspaper cadence: six dailies + a Sunday)
logline: A comments section exists. Wood draws it: stick figures at the back of every panel, commenting.

panels.composition: Wood's room. WOOD at the monitor. Below the strip on screen, a comments box: two comments. At the back of the panel, drawn small, two stick figures reading over his shoulder.

characters.pose: two stick figures at the back of the panel

image.prompt: a young man at a bulky computer whose screen shows a comic with two comments beneath it, and two small stick figures drawn at the back of the panel reading over his shoulder, muddy digital flats
image.notes: The chorus: stick figures, always at the back, always small. They grow. This is the seed of the 2006 parody.

panels.composition: Wood, turning to the stick figures.

characters.pose: turning to the back of the panel

image.prompt: a young man turning in his chair to address two stick figures standing at the back of his bedroom panel

balloons.text: Boise. Seven years in the laundromat and my first readers are in Boise.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man staring at a monitor, bemused, monitor glow

panels.composition: Wood drawing. The dog. The two stick figures now sitting on the bed, watching, as if they live there. They do now.

image.prompt: a young man drawing at his table while two small stick figures sit on the bed behind him watching, a dog on the floor, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy early-digital flats begin
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in over-wet watercolor

notes: The Greek chorus arrives. Two stick figures from Boise.
